scope_statement: An independent criticism-tested reconstruction of Software Product Line Engineering as systematic engineering of related products through warranted commonality, managed variability, reusable assets and a defined derivation approach. Covers the ten mandated domain families, named historical/adoption/realisation/dynamic branches, and relevant evidence through 2026-09-06.
scope_boundaries: Not an exhaustive census of every publication, vendor, industry or national research programme. Saturation concerns the explicit questions and registered candidate mechanisms.
No requester repositories, prior Evolved packets, sibling corpora or target-specific designs were consulted.
Adjacent architecture, maintenance, control, ecosystems and learned-tool work is imported only with its source/transfer boundaries; no cross-trifecta synthesis is claimed.
No legal advice or invented standard clauses: external obligations are inputs and ISO evidence is limited to public scope.
No universal effect sizes, product-count thresholds, unqualified family proofs or claims of current industrial adoption from conference programmes.

families.NAME: Product-family scope and evidence of commonality
QUESTIONS: Which shared assumptions warrant this family, and which plausible product would invalidate them?
Is the evidence for commonality independent of superficial implementation similarity?
What useful product possibility justifies the incremental variability burden?

saturation_rationale.RULE: Continue searching when evidence could alter a candidate, prerequisite, genealogy relation, criticism or composition judgement; stop equivalent retrieval when it no longer changes those decisions.
DECISION_CHANGING_FINDINGS: Industrial clone-and-own evidence prevented an unconditional product-line adoption claim.
Bosch stale-model and heterogeneous-dependency evidence narrowed modelling and extraction claims.
Configuration sampling and JHipster evidence separated encoded validity, derivation and product behaviour.
Feature/test evolution and dynamic-control work added distinct continuity and transition obligations.
2026 regeneration and small-configurability work produced an unresolved replacement candidate and a separately rejected broad behavioural inference.
Support-aware retirement was separated from initial variability admission rather than hidden in one broad slogan.
saturation_rationale.STOPPING_JUDGEMENT: The registered mechanisms and their principal rival approaches, failure modes, selection conditions and evidence boundaries have dispositions; later equivalent search themes did not require another mechanism or a changed primary judgement. This is a bounded expert synthesis, not a claim of statistical literature completeness.
saturation_rationale.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Open questions are explicitly examined and retained in properties, evidence records and composition obligations; inaccessible source content is not counted as read.

uncompleted_burdens_explanation: No mandatory family or registered candidate remains NOT_EXAMINED. Access limitations and unsettled research questions are separately recorded rather than concealed as completion.
